topic: InfiMotion TL300: first mass-produced EV drive unit with magnesium-aluminum alloy housing. 109.5 kg for 340 kW dual motors. Galvanic corrosion mitigation, 360-degree bidirectional oil cooling as structural enabler, W-pin hairpin topology, SiC/IGBT hybrid power electronics, adjustable magnetic field motor. Materials science crossover.
last_run_note: Published #79 (InfiMotion TL300 magnesium-aluminum alloy EV motor housing, 9.14/10) — deployed to Cloudflare Pages. Next article #80 (watches category) to be researched on next run.
